verdicts.reason: A is scattered. The headline is oversized, wraps to 3 lines with an orphaned 'duo' jammed against the bottom edge, and the body copy is pushed to the top-right, where it sits on the pink circle and crowds the serum bottle. The jar floats loose below, and the CTA, bottle and copy form a cramped cluster with no shared alignment. B keeps the one-line headline, readable subcopy and a clear logo, but it is still broken. The CTA sits left of the headline, so it is read first and nearly touches it, and 'duo' runs into the circle. The serum bottle is shrunk to an unreadable speck under the subcopy, which loses half of 'the duo' message, while the jar is oversized. B is less chaotic overall.
